the link between movement and perception.
the active exploration of oriented textures.
the link between movement direction and haptically perceived orientation.

the finger movements are adjusted in a manner that is optimal for the perception of the texture.

the perception of oriented textures is closely linked to the movement direction.
the perception of texture properties is closely linked to the movements that explore the texture.

finger movements are tightly linked to texture perception.
the natural haptic exploration of textured objects is not a random walk but a directed exploration that is adapted to the object’s properties.
